title: GTAFL: Addressing Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning in Medical Image
abstract: arXiv:2611.08021v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In healthcare, protecting patient privacy is crucial due to the sensitivity of medical data and its extensive accessibility. Federated Learning (FL) offers a decentralized and privacy-preserving training paradigm, making it an ideal solution for healthcare applications. A critical challenge in healthcare is that real-world medical data often exhibits long-tailed distributions in local and global views. Existing methods addressing long-tailed FL problem typically assume that the model will be evaluated on uniform test data distribution. However, practical test data in healthcare systems is often agnostic and unpredictable, leading to potential model failures in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we introduce a novel task termed Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning and propose GTAFL, a comprehensive framework to address this challenge. translated_title: GTAFL：解决医学图像中测试不可知的长尾联邦学习问题
translated_abstract: 在医疗保健领域，由于医疗数据的敏感性及其广泛的可获取性，保护患者隐私至关重要。联邦学习（FL）提供了一种去中心化且保护隐私的训练范式，使其成为医疗保健应用的理想解决方案。医疗保健领域的一个关键挑战在于，现实世界中的医疗数据在局部和全局视角下往往呈现长尾分布。现有解决长尾联邦学习问题的方法通常假设模型将在均匀分布的测试数据上进行评估。然而，医疗保健系统中的实际测试数据往往是不可知且不可预测的，这可能导致模型在现实场景中失效。在本文中，我们提出了一个新任务——测试不可知长尾联邦学习，并提出了GTAFL，一个应对该挑战的综合框架。在训练阶段，GTAFL采用自适应重采样、专家分类器重训练以及……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了“测试不可知长尾联邦学习”这一新任务，并设计GTAFL综合框架，通过自适应重采样和专家分类器重训练等策略，解决医疗图像联邦学习中数据长尾分布且测试分布不可预测导致模型失效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the novel task of Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning and proposes GTAFL, a comprehensive framework leveraging adaptive re-sampling and expert classifier retraining to address long-tailed medical image data with unpredictable test distributions in federated learning.
